Founded in 1996, the Tritones are UC San Diego’s premiere vocal ensemble. United by a passion for singing and music, the Tritones seek to foster a nurturing environment for all undergraduates looking to pursue a cappella during their college career. They strive to promote a cappella music throughout the UC San Diego community and greater San Diego area through performance and volunteering.

To serve the African American and minority communities by introducing a Historically Black College-inspired dance form, founded by African American women. This initiative is designed to promote cultural pride, empower women through dance, and create a supportive, inclusive space for minority women at UC San Diego. By honoring heritage and fostering unity, we aim to build a stronger sense of community and belonging on campus.

This club serves as a safe space for the adoptee community as well as anyone interested in learning about the community. I want this club to help build connections and foster new friendships among the adoptee community through volunteering and raising money for those in foster care and other communities in need.

Organization Name: Tritons for HHT Awareness at UC San Diego
Description: Tritons for HHT Awareness at UC San Diego is a student organization committed to raising awareness of Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia (HHT), a rare and underdiagnosed genetic vascular disorder. Our mission is to educate students, future healthcare providers, and the broader community about the clinical features, diagnostic challenges, and treatment considerations surrounding HHT. As the only student-led HHT organization in the UC system, we strive to bridge the gap between genetics, public health, and patient-centered care, highlighting how early awareness can change outcomes.

Tritons For Israel is the pro-Israel student organization at UC San Diego. We are dedicated to raising awareness about Israel and celebrating Israeli culture, educating students and encouraging dialogue, as well as promoting peace in the Middle East.

Tritons Roll Out is a student-led roller skating organization dedicated to building community, promoting wellness, and encouraging self-expression through skating. Our purpose is to create a fun, inclusive space where students of all skill levels can connect, learn, and enjoy the art and sport of roller skating both on and off campus.

TritonThenix allows students to achieve a deeper understanding and ability in the art of calisthenics. TritonThenix supports students in developing confidence through consistent training and community involvement. All experience levels are welcome in the organization.
The TRUTH Club (Taking Real Understanding to Heart) focuses on learning the Bible and putting into practice the commands of God, rather than following man-made traditions.

Organization Name: Turning Point USA at UC San Diego
Description: Turning Point USA's purpose is to promote American values and free market capitalism while sparking civil and productive discourse amongst participants who may disagree with one another.

Organization Name: Tzu Chi Collegiate Association at UC San Diego
Description: Tzu Chi Collegiate Association at UC San Diego is a non-profit student organization, which aims to inspire college-level students in the mindful practice of the Tzu Chi Foundation’s principles of Gratitude, Respect, and Love through service at the local community level. Tzu Ching promote the universal value of “Great Love” through the Tzu Chi Foundation’s missions of Charity, Medicine, Education, Culture, International Relief, Bone Marrow Donation, Environmental Protection and Community Service. Through mindful practice of Founder Dharma Master Cheng Yen’s teachings, Tzu Ching hope to purify people's minds and bring positive influence into the community.

UBIC is a non-profit organization whose purpose is to serve Undergraduates interested in Bioinformatics by providing resources for students entering the growing discipline; furthering access to job, internship, and research opportunities; facilitating an open forum for discussion, collaboration, and socialization; holding 2-3 events per week; and acting as a collective voice for bioinformatics students at UCSD.

The Undergraduate Communication Society (UCS) provides Communication majors and related fields with opportunities to build connections, develop skills, and explore career paths. By working closely with faculty, UCS helps students learn more about the major, gain professional guidance, and discover post-graduation possibilities. Through social and academic events, community outreach, and an active social media presence, UCS fosters a supportive community within the department and across UC San Diego. Students can also join committees including Graphic Design, Public Relations, Event Planning, Social Media, Administration, and Media Journalism to gain hands-on experience and grow in areas that match their interests.

Organization Name: Undergraduate Economics Society at UC San Diego
Description: The purpose of the Organization is to develop a community of students and faculty members interested in business and economics while providing students with resources and opportunities to start their careers.

The Undergraduate History Network is a student-led organization focused on working with the undergraduate history department at UCSD, serving as a student voice on department initiatives and events aimed at supporting undergraduates. The UHN also works to create resources, events, programs, and networks for undergraduate history students, and supporting them during their time at UC San Diego.

Organization Name: Undergraduate Law Review at UC San Diego
Description: Undergraduate Law Review at UC San Diego offers an accessible platform for students interested in legal discussion and reflection. The journal aims to publish exemplary works submitted by undergraduate students on relevant and impactful issues, with an emphasis on legal scholarship. Through publication, we hope to not only provide resources for, but also encourage intellectual exploration for students interested in a legal or academic career.

Organization Name: Undergraduate MD-PhD Society (UMPS) at UC San Diego
Description: The Undergraduate MD/PhD Society (UMPS) is a student-led 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to empowering all undergraduate students—especially those who are underserved or underrepresented—to pursue MD/PhD, MD, PhD, and other graduate-level careers in medicine and science. With over 1,200 members across UC San Diego, UCLA, and UC Irvine, UMPS provides clinical training, research preparation, mentorship, and leadership opportunities to help students thrive on their path to advanced study.

Organization Name: Undergraduate Women in Computing at UC San Diego
Description: WIC is a non-profit student organization committed to fostering a supportive and informative environment for women in computing related fields through technical, professional development, and social events. We also focus on high school outreach programs to bring more young women into the field. Keynote speakers, career fair information, interview preparation, and awareness about relevant CS conferences are few of the opportunities that will be provided for our members. Furthermore, we strive to empower our members to leave UCSD with the goal of making a positive difference in the world by promoting equity, diversity, inclusion, leadership, and accessibility throughout their career paths. Through our initiatives and programs, we aim to instill in our members a sense of responsibility to contribute to a more equitable and inclusive tech industry and society at large.
We are a Christ-inspired nonprofit organization that dents Middle Eastern poverty through supporters like you.

The United Accounting Society at UC San Diego strives to assist students in pursuing their interests and goals with respect to the accounting industry. We seek to provide students opportunities to learn more about the accounting industry, form connections with professionals, and meet other students with interests in accounting. We hope to help students achieve a smooth transition into the professional working world by helping them develop professionally.

Organization Name: United Taiwanese Association at UC San Diego
Description: UTA’s purpose is to ensure the success of United Taiwanese Association (UTA) and its continuation as one of the largest non-profit student-run Asian-interest socio cultural organizations at UC San Diego. UTA aims to strengthen social networks, celebrate Asian culture, and promote academic merit.

Urban Changemakers serves as a placemaking, project-based organization to promote & improve the well-being of students, faculty, and staff. We seek to foster a greater sense of community through healthy placemaking both on and off-campus.

Organization Name: VAW Global at UC San Diego
Description: The purpose of Volunteers Around the World Global Health Alliances Health Outreach is to provide medical education and organize free mobile clinics to underserved communities, both locally and internationally. The organization aims to enhance the well-being of individuals through volunteer services, educational programs, and community outreach initiatives. Additionally, the organization fosters a supportive community among members and encourages professional development, cultural exchange, and a commitment to service. The primary focus of club meetings is to develop a plan for a medical-related internship in underserved communities abroad (ex. Guatemala, Dominican Republic, Peru, Cambodia, Uzbekistan, etc.).

Organization Name: Venture Capital Finance and Innovation Club
Description: Founded in 2018, our club strives to educate Rady School students about the venture capital and finance industries. We believe in using our analytical skill-sets, combined with quality communication, to bring together teams and innovative ideas for the benefit of the San Diego Community. Building upon the entrepreneurial spirit of the Rady School, our club offers members insight into how new companies are created, pitched, evaluated, and funded.

Organization Name: Vertical Flight Society @ UC San Diego
Description: To showcase and educate to all students the growing engineering industry that is vertical flight.

Organization Name: Video Game Development Club (VGDC) at UC San Diego
Description: The purpose of the Video Game Development Club is to aid students interested in video game development to produce games and learn skills relating to game design, game programming, art & animation, music & sound effect production, dialogue & story writing, and more. The club shall serve as an interdisciplinary forum where members can discuss video games and seek like-minded teammates from various disciplines to participate in club and personal projects. The club shall provide structure in hosting various projects and game making competitions, in addition to hosting educational workshops for all skill levels to learn and participate.

The Vietnamese American Pharmacy Student Association (VAPSA) is a cultural and professional organization that welcomes pharmacy students from all backgrounds, promoting Vietnamese heritage, community, and leadership. VAPSA seeks to support academic, professional, and personal growth among its members, foster mentorship and leadership development, and advocate for representation in pharmacy and healthcare. Through educational initiatives, community outreach, and service, VAPSA strives to improve the health and well-being of the communities we serve while empowering future leaders in pharmacy.
To promote and preserve the Vietnamese culture and awareness among the UCSD students through various cultural, social, community, and educational events.

The purpose of the Volleyball Enthusiasts is to be a hub where those harboring any amount of interest in volleyball can come together and learn more about the sport. Unlike the current competitive nature of volleyball organizations on campus currently, this organization is being built as a relaxed environment where everybody can learn about how to play the game at their own pace, along with learning about related topics such as general fitness and the professional sport.
Academics Discipleship Learning and Innovation Vocation and Expertise Leadership Development Word of Faith Prayer Mission to Nations and Peoples

WAV stands for "with a vision." We are a community of believers in San Diego committed to help college students discover who Jesus is & grow deeper in their relationship with Him. We want to inspire students to share in God’s vision for our campuses & beyond.

We are WAV Rec—a group of students who wants to build connection and memories during our time in college. We host a variety of social events and fun workshops, like cooking classes, food trips around SD, board game and snack nights, and (ofc) sports like volleyball and basketball! Beyond a purely social org, we also like to engage in deeper conversation as we spend time together—exploring themes like the meaning and purpose of life, significance and worth, each others' passion and interests, and what God has to do in any of this. Though we share views from a Christian perspective (and invite you to ask questions and explore!), we warmly welcome anyone from any background.

We the Redeemed is the English-speaking congregation of San Diego Korean United Presbyterian Church. Members of We the Redeemed strive to be transformed people who genuinely know and love God and are part of a community that seeks to obey His will wholeheartedly. This student organization exists to provide a campus community, accountability, and outreach for college students—both committed members and those exploring Christianity—to grow in and share the good news of Christ.

Weightlifting at UC San Diego is a community that aims to promote growth in the practice and community of the sport of Olympic Weightlifting. We seek to create a friendly, welcoming environment in which anyone, regardless of experience or goals, can learn to improve their strength, especially in the Snatch and Clean and Jerk.

Women in Business @ UC San Diego is committed to empowering women from all backgrounds to become leaders in today’s dynamic world. Through a combination of business education, networking opportunities, mentorship, leadership development workshops, and social events, members will join a supportive community dedicated to helping one another succeed. By fostering both professional and personal growth, Women in Business @ UC San Diego aims to equip women pursuing business with the tools to drive change not only within themselves and the university but also in the broader world they aspire to impact.

Organization Name: Women in Chemical Sciences @ UC San Diego (WiCS)
Description: Our mission is to foster a community for inspiring the pursuit of gender equality in STEM. We work toward our mission in four areas. First, we raise gender bias awareness and teach prevention of unconscious bias in STEM workplaces. Through professional development we prepare for success through informative career-building events such as seminars and networking opportunities. With outreach we inspire the next generation of scientists, with an emphasis on underrepresented groups. Finally, we promote well-being by improving mental and physical wellness through community activities, social gatherings, and individualized mentorship.

To build a community among graduate women in Electrical and Computer Engineering to enhance their career opportunities. While this organizations targets women in ECE, they welcome members from all gender identities

The purpose of this club is to create an inclusive space for women who are majoring, minoring, or simply interested in the field of mathematics. We will host events to offer study breaks, provide opportunities to meet new people, and organize collaborative study sessions. Through our events, members can connect with their peers outside of the classroom and help foster a supportive community on campus.

Organization Name: Women in Science Society at UC San Diego
Description: Women in Science Society (WSS) at UC San Diego is dedicated to empowering, supporting, and uplifting women pursuing careers in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM). Through informative workshops, networking events, and high-impact volunteer opportunities, we provide resources and opportunities to help our members thrive both academically and personally during their studies at UC San Diego. Our goal is to foster a community of respect, motivation, and inclusivity within the scientific field.

The purpose of this organization is to support and empower marginalized genders in the aeronautic and astronautic fields. Women currently make up less than 20% of the aeronautics and astronautics industry, and while there are many reasons for that, WoAA seeks to inspire a change in that statistic. Through organization, networking, and volunteering, WoAA empowers individuals to grow and challenge themselves both personally and professionally.

Organization Name: Women's Club Basketball @ UC San Diego
Description: Our club’s purpose is to bring together a group of students who are passionate about playing basketball together and in a competitive and structured environment. We aim to create an empowering and supportive space where students of all skill levels can confidently play, grow, and thrive in basketball, fostering community, learning, and a love for the game in a safe and welcoming environment. The club is focused on women-identifying students but is open to all who are interested. The club will be composed of players that have tried out and were selected to play on our competitive team by the coaching staff and officers. Along with this roster of players, we welcome anyone who did not make the official roster to the club also, as well as anyone else who is interested in playing basketball to join us at our practices as our goal is to provide a safe and welcoming environment to students interested in expanding their game.

Wushu Club at UC San Diego strives to develop the trainings and techniques of Wushu to anyone interested in the Chinese martial art, whether experienced or not. We aim to establish a community where those who participate can feel welcomed to learn and practice forms, train their bodies physically and mentally, compete and perform, and create new bonds with fellow peers.

Xclusive Dance Showcase at UC San Diego is a sustainable and community-based platform, dedicated to celebrating the creativity, passion, and care that permeates the UC San Diego dance community. Through hosting various events, including an annual showcase, Xclusive aims to not only celebrate the dancers, but to create a supportive, welcoming space for the dancers to share their performances/works.

The goal of this organization is to create a place where Black students and allies feel comfortable and confident to showcase Black culture and experiences on and/or off campus. This organization's intended impact is to help unite students and highlight Black culture in spaces that predominantly exclude Black people. Our organization members will join a community of students who share similar backgrounds and experiences or want to learn more about the black experience.

Youth Empowerment in Science is a volunteer organization dedicated to inspiring a passion for science in underrepresented areas of San Diego by developing and implementing hands-on workshops in elementary schools. We understand that not all communities have the same access to STEM education opportunities. That's why we're committed to reaching those underserved areas, sparking curiosity, and breaking down barriers to learning. Our workshops are designed to engage and inspire students, connecting science to their everyday lives and interests. With Y.E.S., you're not just teaching science, you're empowering the next generation of scientists, engineers, and innovators from all backgrounds. Join us in creating a future where every child has the opportunity to say 'YES' to the amazing world of science. To find out more or apply to be a general member check out our instagram @yesatucsd.

Organization Name: Yalla, Lets Talk! at UC San Diego
Description: The purpose and goal of this organization is to provide a space for MENA (Middle Eastern and North African) students and those who are interested in learning various dialects in the Arabic language. The organization will be promoting the unity that languages should bring instead of the isolation of communities and culture. Organization members will be able to practice and strengthen their use of the Arabic language. They will also be joining a much larger supportive community in learning the various dialects in the language and be exposed to MENA cultures through food and drink tasting, music, dancing, etc.

At Yonder Deep we are working towards being the first undergraduate organization to develop a 3D printed, low cost, Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (AUV) which allows for the implementation of several sensor types for the purpose of oceanographic and climate change research. Every member will have access to lab space at MESOM laboratory at the Scripps Institute of Oceanography where we conduct all of our exciting rapid prototyping, software development and testing!

To provide hands-on robotics experience to students by developing a Mars rover to compete in the international University Rover Challenge. Students will gain both specialized and interdisciplinary experience in the mechanical, electrical, scientific, and software subsystems essential to the success of a competitive Mars rover.
To advocate for public policies consistent with the Sharon Statement.

Organization Name: Young People's Alliance at UC San Diego
Description: The Young People's Alliance at UC San Diego is a nonpartisan movement of students across the US, fighting for youth voices in politics. We mobilize young people to get engaged in politics through student voter registration, election turnout promotion, various civic engagement events, and opportunities to advocate to policymakers. We plan to host guest legislator speaker events, debate & election couch parties, and voter registration drives at UC San Diego every quarter to engage young people in politics. We also support youth-based advocacy across the US, advocating for innovative initiates to increase youth power in US politics.

Young Planners' Society (YPS) is a career oriented network for undergraduate USP students and those who are interested in city planning and related careers. Founded in Fall 2018, YPS hosts events that alternate between social opportunities and professional/educational development. Each year, YPS also incorporates faculty involvement and community site visits. In addition, YPS aims to connect students with both regional planning-oriented companies and local jurisdiction planning agencies to facilitate professional mentorship opportunities for students. Young Planners' Society is represented as a nationally registered planning student organization under the American Planning Association (APA) California chapter, and is locally represented under the San Diego APA section.

To promote understanding of Alzheimer’s and healthy aging among youth and young adults by providing unique opportunities to volunteer with those afflicted by Alzheimer’s and advocate for change. Our purpose is to raise funds for research and support treatment and care, ultimately contributing to the movement in finding a cure for this neurodegenerative disease. Organization Name: Zor (Hindi Film) Dance Team at UC San Diego
Description: Zor is UCSD's premier competitive Bollywood-Fusion dance team. We travel across the country to compete in the collegiate Bollywood circuit. Additionally, we hope to explore and express aspects of South Asian culture through dance.
